title: SmtpRelayQueue has no Debug impl — limits logging and test assertions
description: pub struct SmtpRelayQueue has no #[derive(Debug)]. The DkimSigner field type may not implement Debug (mail_auth crate), so derive may not be possible. But there is no manual Debug impl either. A public type without Debug cannot be used in {:?} format strings, which limits debugging and test assertions. If the DkimSigner field prevents derive, a manual Debug impl that omits the signer (printing 'DkimSigner(...)') would satisfy the requirement.
